svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.18k stars in total, about 1.75k a year earlier. jactionlint 311, mr boxington 683, aube 2060, fnox 2355, hk 1299, pitchfork 704, usage 1069, +6 more 697.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
